tasks.title: Sufficient chain: direct, inferred, and cannot determine
tasks.focus: Distinguish direct teaching, one licensed inference, and an unsupported relation.

turns.content:
We are doing a short fictional logic puzzle. A, B, C, and D are only labels. In this puzzle, "links" is a made-up relation; do not use outside knowledge about links.

I teach you these facts:
- A links to B.
- B links to C.
- A links to D.
Both A-B and B-C are marked active.

Puzzle rule: for these tokens, if X links to Y and Y links to Z, and both links are marked active, then X links to Z.

Answer three questions using only what I taught:
1. Does A link to D? Was that taught directly, inferred, or can you not tell?
2. Does A link to C? Was that taught directly, inferred, or can you not tell?
3. Does C link to A? Was that taught directly, inferred, or can you not tell?
For anything inferred, give the premises and the rule you used.

tasks.title: Explicitly active exception
tasks.focus: The exception blocks the rule; do not infer A-C and do not claim that A-C is false.

turns.content:

tasks.title: Correction after a licensed inference
tasks.focus: Q1 licenses one inference; T2 only processes the correction; Q2 must not reuse the old B-C fact and must preserve the negation.

turns.content:
We are doing a short fictional logic puzzle. A, B, and C are only labels. In this puzzle, "links" is a made-up relation; do not use outside knowledge about links.

I teach you these facts:
- A links to B.
- B links to C.

Puzzle rule: for these tokens, if X links to Y and Y links to Z, then X links to Z.
Does A link to C? Use only what I taught. If you infer it, mark it.
Correction: I was wrong about B links to C. B does not link to C. Everything else I taught is still current.
Now report what is currently taught about A, B, and C, and whether A links to C follows. Use only the corrected facts.

tasks.title: Revocation after a licensed inference
tasks.focus: Q1 licenses one inference; T2 only processes the revocation; Q2 must keep the two relation facts but not use the revoked rule.

I withdraw the chain rule. It no longer applies in this puzzle. The two link facts A-B and B-C are still current. There is no replacement rule.
